title: Mom's 1974 Baby Grand (Decent Sampler 1.5, Pianobook)
author: The Imperfect Drummer (Brian Peat), pianobook.co.uk/profile/imperfectdrummer
instrument: a 1974 Wm. Knabe & Co. baby grand piano, reconditioned with its felts sanded, per the library's README
capture: one pair of sE 8 cardioids in X/Y at the hammers, lid fully open, 48 kHz/24-bit stereo WAV
pitch_names: the library names A0 (MIDI 21) A-1 and middle C C3; ids carry MIDI numbers
velocity_layers: three, by the preset: Soft 1-48, Med 49-104, Hard 105-127; Soft and Med have one to three round robins, Hard one take played in all three positions
levels: every note take is peak-normalised by layer (Soft -11.9, Med -9.9, Hard -7.9 dBFS); the decoder gives each layer Decent Sampler's velocity gain v/127 at its velocity midpoint against Hard's (Soft -13.33 dB, Med -3.56 dB) and each take a smooth trend over the keyboard: gain_db per take, from its recorded_db (50-750 ms RMS); see Tools/decode_belmont.py
mixing: the preset plays the notes at its Key Vol default 0.3, the key releases and pedal noises at 0.1 with each sample at +6 dB, and a reverb; the fit applies none of them
processing: the README says the takes were cleaned of clicky keys and buzzes and may be processed and cleaned too much
decoding: pedal-up notes at the gains above, key releases and pedal noises as recorded; no trim, resampling, denoising or EQ
